metadata.timestamp_note: EXIF capture timestamps are absent in the source JPEGs; deterministic synthetic monotonic ISO-8601 timestamps are used solely to enforce sequence ordering without fabricating real capture times.
metadata.exif_orientation_note: removal/V02.jpeg through V05.jpeg store 1200x1600 raw pixels with EXIF Orientation=6 (90 CW); OpenCV cv2.imread applies EXIF orientation and loads all 30 images at 1600x1200.
